verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax documents automated filing for US sales tax only, through its TaxJar integration. That is a real first-party filing path, but it is limited to one country and relies on a partner. Community comments say non-US remittance (UK/EU) is still handled manually, and nothing in the evidence mentions a guarantee covering late-filing penalties. Missing for 10: filing and remittance in every registered jurisdiction (non-US), confirmed automatic remittance of funds, an on-time filing guarantee with penalty coverage, and hands-on corroboration of the filing flow.

support.subject: As a finance lead, returns are prepared, filed, and remitted automatically in every registered jurisdiction — on time, with the vendor's guarantee covering penalties if it files late

citations.quote: Stripe Tax integrates with TaxJar to automate filing for US sales tax, helping you file on time and avoid errors that can occur with manual filing.
Stripe Tax integrates with TaxJar for automatic US tax filing
